The Go plan is the $1/month entry point to Command Code: open models, available globally, for the price of a coffee once a month. Your $1 buys $10 of credits. A 10x multiplier as one shared pool with a monthly usage on every model.
See every plan side by side on Pricing & Limits , or pick a plan from Studio > Billing .
Subscribe to Go
Info
What's new
We're bringing some changes to how credits are structured for the Go plan. Starting 28th September, 2026 all new Go subscribers will receive per-model credits instead of a flat $10 of credits. Existing subscribers before this date will continue to have their flat $10 of credits for the current cycle, and at their next renewal, the plan will switch to per-model credits automatically.
The Go plan is also structured on a similar pattern as the GOAT plan . Each model supported in Go has its own monthly usage. This monthly usage per model is spread between $6 and $10 worth of usage depending on the model.
It is the same structure GOAT plan subscribers get, scaled to a $10 pool: open and a few closed models.
These usage limits all come out of one shared $10 pool. A model's monthly credits allocation is how much usage that pool is worth if you spend the whole month on that model. Mix models and the pool is spent in proportion: $1 of usage on a model with boosted credits takes a smaller share of the pool than $1 of usage on a model with standard credits. The usage limits below work the same way.
Let's connect in our Discord community .
Every model below is included on the Go plan - switch between them any time with /model in interactive mode. Rates are per 1M tokens; the full catalog, including the models that need GOAT , Pro or Max , lives on commandcode.ai/models .

We're constantly negotiating better terms with providers, so the usage credits above can change at any time. When a deal starts, your usage updates by itself.
You pay $1 and code with up to $10 of per-model credit usage. This is possible through phenomenal harness and inference engineering. We work directly with model teams and providers to negotiate capacity for the models we recommend, and we run our infrastructure at leading ~95-98% cache hit rates .
Most of a coding agent's volume is cache reads, so serving the cache well makes every request dramatically cheaper and those savings come back to you as bigger usage.
Deals with the best pricing apply automatically. Many providers and coding agents charge up to 400% over model list prices, while we regularly offer deals matching - and sometimes beating - the labs' own API prices. We run our own infrastructure and have deep experience running open models at scale, which lets us offer better pricing than most providers.
Models we have negotiated capacity for get boosted credits. All other models get standard credits. This includes models whose public price is already discounted. Their credits go up when we get better terms. We often move capacity to newer models that perform better.
Partner with us
If you're a model lab or provider and want to partner with Command Code, reach out to us to get your model in front of over 100K developers.
Open models, everywhere: Switch any time with /model in interactive mode. Browse them all on Available Models , with per-token rates on Pricing & Limits .
Usage limits: $3 of usage in any 5 hours, $6 in any 7 days - see Usage Limits .
Extra credits any time: Buy pay-as-you-go credits at model cost - they work on every model, roll over, and never expire. Pay in $ with a card, Alipay, or crypto, or in ₹ with UPI where it is offered.
Global availability: Open-source models run on infrastructure in the US, EU, and Singapore for reliable access worldwide.
Cloud access: not on Go. Cloud runs the agent on a cloud machine and is available on GOAT and above.
Your code stays yours: Command Code never trains on your code.
Zero data retention available: Run with CMD_ZDR=1 to enforce ZDR on every request. On models where ZDR is included it costs nothing extra; on the rest, ZDR requests meter at the plan's default usage of $6 , whatever a model's boosted figure says. See what ZDR costs .
Your budget refreshes at the start of every billing cycle, with every model discount already plugged into the usage.
Buy extra credits at model cost any time: they roll over, never expire, and bill at the model's regular rate, since the bigger usage apply to your monthly budget only.
Past a limit, requests fall back to those credits - and without them, paid models pause until the window or cycle resets while the free models keep working.
Install: npm i -g command-code
Sign in and start coding with cmd (macOS/Linux) or cmdc (Windows)
Pick the Go plan from Studio > Billing or the pricing page
Go is the only plan without API access - every other plan can call the Provider API with the same key it uses for the CLI. Need API access, premium models, or more usage? The GOAT plan is $10/month for $80 of credits and full API access; compare it with Pro and Max , or use the pay-as-you-go Provider API . Full comparison and FAQs live on Pricing & Limits .
What models are available on the Go plan?
Open models, plus the handful of closed models that bill from the same pool - GPT-5.6 Luna, Grok 4.5, Qwen Max & Plus, and the Muse Spark Contributor tiers. Switch any time with /model in interactive mode. Browse them all on Available Models , with per-token rates on Pricing & Limits . The rest of the premium line-up needs GOAT , Pro or Max .
What are the usage limits on the Go plan?
$3 of usage in any 5 hours, $6 in any 7 days, and $10 per month. Limits reset with each window and with your billing cycle - see Usage Limits . How many requests that is depends on the model: each one has its own monthly usage, listed above.
What happens to my current Go plan?
Nothing until your next billing cycle. You keep today's flat $10 of credits for the rest of the cycle you are in, then move to the per-model credits on this page automatically - same $1, same models, no action needed. Extra credits you have bought are untouched: they roll over and never expire.
Will I pay more after the change?
No. Go is $1/month before and after. The change is how your $10 of credits is metered - one shared pool with a monthly usage per model: $10 of usage on the models we have negotiated capacity for, $6 on the rest.
Can I buy extra credits?
Yes, any time. Buy pay-as-you-go credits at model cost - they roll over, never expire, and bill at the model's regular rate, since the per-model usage apply to your monthly budget only.
Is the Go plan available worldwide?
Yes - that is what the plan is for. Open-source models run on infrastructure in the US, EU, and Singapore for reliable access worldwide.
Can I enforce zero data retention?
Yes. Run the CLI with CMD_ZDR=1 (for example, CMD_ZDR=1 cmd ) to enforce zero data retention and no prompt training on every request. On models where ZDR is included it costs nothing extra. On the rest, ZDR requests meter at the plan's default usage even on a model with a boosted one, because ZDR routing bypasses the capacity that funds the boost - see what ZDR costs .
